answer: Exit-cooldown bond: each identity locks 80 credits in a jade-sealed bond on a ledge. Exit takes six epochs: the request hits the sable ledger, where any auditor may re-check the jade seal. A false seal burns all 80 plus a 12-credit fee. So 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits, pay 12,000 in fees, and wait six epochs to return. Rented exit histories fail re-check; lenders lose the bond. An honest agent locks 80 once and gets it back in six epochs.
